notes: HD 271791 is a previously identified unbound disk-runaway star for which this paper newly tabulates v_ej using Gaia DR2 proper motions (T:p4-b4, note b); it is therefore treated as follow_up rather than a new candidate. PG 1610+062 is excluded because the authors explicitly state that it is “still gravitationally bound” (T:p3-b8) and “not gravitationally unbound” (T:p4-b6). Other Table 5 entries are not individually established as Galactic unbound candidates, and the paper’s “most of the other unbound disk runaway candidates” statement does not explicitly cover every member.

HD 271791: HD 271791 is only discussed as a comparison object in Table 5 and Sect. 5 of this paper. Table 5 lists its ejection velocity relative to the rotating Galactic disk as 390^{+70}_{-30} km/s (1 sigma); because this is a disk-relative ejection velocity and not the star's total Galactic rest-frame speed, it is not entered under galactic_rest_frame_velocity. No equatorial coordinates, parallax, proper motions, or radial velocity values for HD 271791 are reported numerically in the paper; its distance and radial velocity are simply adopted from Heber et al. (2008).
